Bill.BriefDescription: Providing notification stickers to drivers with certain disabilities or impairments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing notification stickers to drivers withcertain disabilities or impairments; adding a new section to chapter46.16 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds and declares that itis the policy of the state of Washington to encourage the safe use ofthe roads by all citizens. In furtherance of this policy and in orderto reduce problematic encounters and interactions between persons withdisabilities and medical and law enforcement personnel, the legislaturefurther finds and declares that the department of licensing shall workwith interested parties to develop a notification sticker thatinterested individuals may place on their vehicle.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In cooperation with the Washington state patrol, the departmentshall work with interested parties to design a notification stickerthat may be used by an individual who has a disability or impairmentthat may affect interactions with medical and law enforcement p. 1 SHB 1152personnel. The sticker must be yellow, bear the international symbolof access, and contain the words "Not a Parking Permit." Thedepartment shall design the sticker to be displayed on the upper lefthand corner of the driver's side front windshield of a vehicle or onthe vehicle's rear license plate, as determined by the departmentduring the design process. Upon completion, the department shall makethe design available to interested parties.
